description: Wave 3c — neutral objects, third pass. Wave 3b PROVED the negative prompt cannot beat the style descriptor's own noun: 'a single warm lantern light' literalized a lantern prop in 28/28 images even with 'lantern' in the negative. Fix: for neutral-object dataset waves the light source is named by MATERIAL ('warm tallow light in cold sunless gloom' — the canon lighting clause verbatim), not by object. Dataset-craft rule earned: Qwen literalizes nouns in style descriptors.
